import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    winpars = 0
    longest = 0
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while "__" in s:
        s = s.replace("__", "_")
    n = len(s)
    if s[i] == '(':
        while j < n and s[j] != ')':
            j += 1
        if j < n and s[j] == ')':
            temp = s[i+1:j]
            if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                winpars += 1
            else:
                parts = temp.split("_")
                winpars += len([p for p in parts if p])
            i = j
    while i < n and s[i] != '(':
        i += 1
        if i < n and s[i] == '(':
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] != ')':
                j += 1
            if j < n and s[j] == ')':
                temp = s[i+1:j]
                if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                    winpars += 1
                else:
                    parts = temp.split("_")
                    winpars += len([p for p in parts if p])
                i = j
    while '(' in s or ')' in s:
        import re
        s = re.sub(r'\([^\(]*\)', '_', s)
    parts = s.split("_")
    for temp in parts:
        if len(temp) > longest:
            longest = len(temp)
    print(longest, winpars)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
